description: Save an F5's configuration, strip the device-specific settings, and store it under a name you choose, ready for f5-load-config. Optionally saves the master key so encrypted values round-trip.
changelog: Cluster members export cleanly (folder device-group / custom traffic-group lines removed, datasync-global objects left out); optional master-key capture to a secret Store entry (<name>-master-key); source cluster settings recorded as comments.
